articles.title: Uflex, US firm Spectra enters race for proposed polymer banknote programme
articles.description: Homegrown polymer science firm Uflex, in partnership with the US-based Spectra Systems, has submitted bids for the proposed polymer banknote programme as the RBI evaluates potential suppliers to manufacture polymer-based currency substrate, sources said. The programme was initiated by Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Pvt Ltd (BRBNMPL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). As per the tender document, it seeks Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP), coated uniformly with opacifying ink to the required colour, along with an anti-static coating, to provide a good surface for printing and ink adhesion. It requires 68,000 reams, 34,000 each for Rs 10 and 20 denominations. Polymer (plastic) currency is used fully or partially by around 60 countries. Australia was the first to introduce it in 1988. articles.title: Delhi govt seeks agency to revive Bharti Delhi Emporium, sets ₹4 crore sales target
articles.description: Delhi has floated a tender to revive Bharti Delhi Emporium, seeking an agency to manage the outlet and achieve a minimum annual sales target of ₹4 crore.

articles.title: Weak monsoon, 30%+ sales growth: 2 CV stocks to watch now
articles.description: The two leading CV makers reported strong vehicle sales growth in the September 2026 quarter - Tata Motors reported a growth of 42.7% y-o-y and for Ashok Leyland it was 31.7% y-o-y. Tata Motors has also launched a voluntary tender offer for Italy-based Iveco Group and it ends on 26 October, 2026. The two leading CV makers have continued their expansion plans despite the continued Middle East crisis coupled with the broadly deficient monsoon season this year.
